title: Better With Friends! (BWF)
description: Have buffs for spending time with your friend!
body:
**This is my first mod** and its still in beta! please dm me in discord if you find any bugs!
My user: **kkk_kk_kk**

## 💖 Always wanted to kiss your friends?

Better With Friends its an mod that gives player buffs when they make actions with friends, and kiss!

Type **`uwu`** or **`*kiss*`** in chat within 2 blocks of a living entity to kiss.
After 3 kisses, you gain the **Kind** status effect for 4 minutes 30 seconds.
- While Kind is active, hostile mobs still spawn but will not attack you.
- While Kind is active, hostile mobs near you will "kiss" you automatically (hearts + purr).

Press the emotion keybind (default `G`, changeable in Controls) to open a quick emote menu that says a phrase and instantly kisses or pats a nearby friend!

This mod can be customized via Settings -> Skin Customization

## 🔥 Another coop actions!

- Holding hands sends a request. If accepted, the requester follows the other player until they crouch!
- Walk together for 5 seconds to gain Haste I while you stay close.
- Sleeping next to a friend grants 5 seconds of Saturation and Regeneration on wake-up.

## 🪶 Features
- Custom kiss achievements based on the two players selected genders.
- Extra silly mod!
- Pink overlay + gentle FOV zoom on interactions (kiss/hug/pat/cuddle/boop/hold hands), plus a pulsing pink overlay while Kind is active.

## 💻 Commands!

/bwf gender <male|female|nonbinary|other>
/bwf config
/bwf randomgender
